settings.pageMainSubtitle: Configure operational gap thresholds, appearance themes, multilingual defaults, and child privacy protections.
settings.errThresholdOrder: Developing threshold must be less than Mastery threshold.
settings.themeLightDesc: Curated warm cream & peach design system from the master landing page.
settings.themeDarkDesc: Deep slate contrast for low-light evening evaluation.
settings.themeSystemDesc: Automatically sync with your operating system preference.
settings.thresholdsDesc: Configure operational cutoffs for flagging student concepts into Mastery, Developing, or Needs Support categories.
settings.thresholdsNote: These thresholds are configurable operational metrics for classroom prioritization, not immutable universal standards. Changing them dynamically recalculates all stored learning gaps.
settings.langSysDesc: Default language and offline assistance engine
settings.recEngineDesc: Works 100% offline with zero paid API keys required.
settings.privacyP1Body: We do not collect home addresses, phone numbers, family financial status, biometric data, or facial images.
settings.privacyP2Body: Students are never labeled with negative terms. The platform uses positive pedagogical phrasing such as "Needs Support," "Developing," and "Ready for Next Step."
settings.privacyP3Body: Individual student scores are confidential to the teacher and parent. Stigmatizing class rank ladders are strictly prohibited.
settings.privacyP4Body: All learning gaps and remedial plans run locally on the school server or device without transmitting children's records to third parties.
settings.auditLogDesc: Cryptographically verified, immutable record of all student mark adjustments.
settings.saveSuccessRecalc: Settings saved! Learning gap statuses recalculated across all students.
settings.tutorialResetMsg: Tutorial & guided walkthrough progress reset! You will see the guided tour on your next visit to any page.
settings.resetModalDesc: This will restore the 15 demonstration students, initial assessment scores, learning gaps, and remedial plans to their original state.
